d:
A world filled with love, beautiful dreams and unforgettable melodies! Enjoy “Chhoti Si Duniya Mohabbat Ki” from the 1992 romantic film Ek Ladka Ek Ladki, featuring Salman Khan and Neelam. Beautifully sung by Udit Narayan and Sadhana Sargam, this charming romantic duet brings back the innocence and musical magic of 90s Bollywood.
Chhoti Si Duniya Mohabbat Ki | Ek Ladka Ek Ladki (1992) | Salman Khanm & Neelam Hits | 90s Love Song
Song: Chhoti Si Duniya Mohabbat Ki
Movie: Ek Ladka Ek Ladki (1992)
Singers: Udit Narayan, Sadhana Sargam
Star Cast: Neelam Kothari, Salman Khan
